text: {"claims": [{"context": "general", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "DNA-PKcs acts as a sensor for DSBs through recruitment by Ku that causes its activation6.", "location": "Introduction", "source": "DSBs", "target": "DNA-PKcs"}, {"context": "general", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "ATR is activated by a wide range of genotoxic stresses, owing to its recruitment by ATRIP to extended tracts of ssDNA coated with the ssDNA binding protein complex, replication protein A (RPA)15.", "location": "Introduction", "source": "genotoxic stresses", "target": "ATR"}, {"context": "general", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "Notable and relevant here is the ATR activation induced at resected DSBs.", "location": "Introduction", "source": "resected DSBs", "target": "ATR"}, {"context": "general", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "ATM activation is further promoted by a C-terminal acetylation induced by DSB-associated chromatin changes exposing the H3K9me3 histone mark that recruits and activates, via shielding from dephosphorylation37, the TIP60/Kat9 acetyltransferase38.", "location": "Introduction", "source": "DSB-associated chromatin changes", "target": "ATM"}, {"context": "82-6 hTert cells", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "Exposure of 82-6 hTert cells to IR induces DSBs as indicated by the formation of 53BP1 foci and activates ATM:", "location": "At low IR doses, the ATM/ATR module is organized as a linear array with ATM upstream and with ATR mainly interfacing with the cell cycle engine through Chk1", "source": "IR", "target": "ATM"}]}
